title: Verifier-Augmented LLM for Multi-Vendor CLI Generation (Preregistered, Hosted-API Confirmatory Run)
research_question: Does integrating a deterministic network verifier into a single generate–verify–repair loop with an LLM improve deterministic verifier pass rates for multi-vendor CLI configuration tasks compared with LLM-only generation?
confirmatory_hypotheses: H1 (primary): The verifier-augmented workflow (guarded) produces a higher task-level verifier pass rate than LLM-only generation (baseline); estimand = paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline.

H2 (secondary): Verifier-augmented generation reduces topological misconfiguration counts (as labeled by deterministic verifier counterexamples) compared with baseline (exploratory-confirmatory stratified analysis).
exploratory_questions: EQ1: Which error classes (syntactic, semantic, topological) benefit most from a single repair iteration?
EQ2: Per-task model-call cost and latency tradeoffs for guarded vs baseline.
benchmark_scope: Synthetic multi‑vendor CLI task set generated under the supplied hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter profile (intent_configuration_repair_v1 task family).
Included vendors: Cisco-like IOS syntax and Juniper-like Junos syntax emulations produced by the deterministic task generator described in the adapter profile.
Task selection deterministic via challenging_workflow_stress_v1 index_rule (see Sampling Plan).
sampling_plan: Use the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 execution adapter in paired (baseline, guarded) mode with task_count = 120. Deterministic task selection: for zero-based ordinal j in 0..119 set cycle = j // 5, offset = [4,5,6,7,8][j % 5], task_index = 8*cycle + offset. This selection is fixed pre-execution and recorded. Per-adapter constraints honored: initial_generation_calls_per_task = 1 (one initial generation per task shared unchanged across paired conditions), maximum_repair_calls_per_task = 1. Model configuration intent: model_provider = "openai_responses", model_name = "gpt-5-mini". Runtime sampling parameters (temperature, top_p, any seed fields) will be recorded in execution metadata; because the adapter does not guarantee deterministic sampling, no claim of eliminated sampling variance is made. Retry policy: one automatic retry only for transient API errors; persistent failures handled per Missingness Plan. Maximum expected model calls = task_count * 2 = 240.
power_and_precision_plan: Primary estimand: paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline. Target effect (MDE): 0.15 absolute paired pass-rate improvement. Power calculation: McNemar/discordant-pair approximation with α=0.05 two-sided, power=0.80, assumed discordant proportion p01+p10≈0.30 → n≈105, rounded up to 120 tasks (recommended scenario). Sensitivity: recompute achieved power and MDE across discordant proportions {0.20,0.30,0.40}; report bootstrap CIs for absolute risk reduction.
exclusion_rules: Deterministic exclusions from primary analysis: tasks flagged 'verifier-unsupported' (verifier returns unsupported-feature or timeout) or 'translation-failure' (vendor_normalizer returns fatal parse error or >1 deterministic token-rewrite to reach vendor grammar). These are excluded from the primary confirmatory counts and recorded with reason codes.
Pairs with irrecoverable persistent infrastructure failure on either condition are excluded from primary analysis ('complete_pair_primary').
missingness_plan: Primary analysis uses 'complete_pair_primary' (exclude task pairs with irrecoverable infrastructure failures on either condition). Preplanned sensitivity analyses: (1) 'complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity' treating any missing guarded call as a guarded failure; (2) publish descriptive audit of excluded pairs with deterministic reason codes (API transient error, adapter transformation failure, verifier runtime error). All excluded-pair hashes and reasons are published in the execution manifest.
analysis_plan: Primary confirmatory analysis executed by the registered executor 'paired_binary_analysis_v1' targeting estimand paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline. Primary test: two-sided exact McNemar test on paired binary verifier pass/fail per task. Report absolute risk difference (guarded − baseline) with 95% CI and an interpretable effect-size measure (Cohen's h or similar for proportions). Primary failed-call treatment: 'complete_pair_primary' (exclude incomplete pairs). Preplanned sensitivity: treat missing guarded calls as failures ('complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity'). Secondary analyses: stratified error-class comparisons (syntactic, semantic, topological) using bootstrap CIs for counts and nonparametric effect sizes; report per-task model-call count and latency distributions (descriptive), preserving pairing. All analyses use recorded deterministic task indices and recorded runtime model-configuration parameters; bootstraps preserve pairing. All code, inputs, and execution metadata are recorded and hashed.
multiplicity_plan: One predeclared primary outcome (verifier pass-rate difference). All other comparisons (error-class strata, latency, cost, qualitative taxonomy) are exploratory/secondary. Report p-values for secondary/exploratory analyses with Benjamini–Hochberg FDR control for descriptive purposes only; do not use secondary p-values to overturn the preregistered primary conclusion.
contamination_plan: Benchmark: hosted_netops_gvr_v1 challenging_workflow_stress_v1 profile. Risk factors: (1) translation/normalizer bugs that alter vendor tokens independent of LLM reasoning; (2) verifier modeling gaps for some control-plane/stateful behaviors; (3) dual-use risk from repair prompts. Detection: instrumentation records parser/normalizer exit codes and diffs; verifier logs include counterexample types mapped to labels; automatic static scan for high-risk content in failing repair prompts prior to release. Flagging rules: 'translation-failure' if parser fatal or >1 token rewrite; 'verifier-unsupported' if verifier returns unsupported-feature or timeout; redact any repair prompts matching dual-use watchlist prior to public release. Analysis treatment: primary analysis excludes flagged 'verifier-unsupported' and 'translation-failure' tasks; sensitivity analyses include flagged tasks with attribution. Redaction of flagged prompts is deterministic and logged.
stopping_rule: Execute the full predeclared set of 120 task indices in sequence. Stop early only if persistent infrastructure or provider outage prevents further execution; in that case log failure reasons and apply Missingness Plan. Do not change task selection based on observed outcomes. The run also stops if maximum_model_calls (240) are exhausted.
planned_outputs: Complete IEEE-format five-page short paper (LaTeX + compiled PDF) including mandatory Disclosure Statement.
Preregistration document (this file) and execution manifest.
Execution artifacts: raw model outputs, verifier logs, normalizer logs, task-index manifest, hashes.
Analysis artifacts: scripts, exact-code-versions, statistical results, bootstrap outputs.
Evidence-to-claim table, nearest-work comparison matrix, autonomous revision log, NotebookLM presentation brief (concise).
